Dirty/unsaved buffers, rapid edits, branch/root changes, missing dependencies, hostile output, provider crashes and interrupt cleanup pass for every promoted profile.
Independent review and governing release checks pass on the final candidate; failures and NOT_RUN evidence remain visible and regressions revert support status.
Documentation and native completion receipts match landed integration; no universal or world-class claim is made from synthetic parity alone.
